episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Vincenzo Cassano's homecoming is met by distrusting tenants and eager fraudsters. Hong Yoo Chan relinquishes his parental rights to Hong Cha Young.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Warned about a scheduled demolition of Geumga Plaza, Vincenzo contrives to thwart the attack. Yoo Chan receives a call from a whistleblower.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Vincenzo warns an impassioned Yoo Chan about the dangers of a new drug and its even more harmful pharmaceutical company. Choi Myung Hee shows her claws.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Fighting fire with fire, Yoo Chan's supporters unite their efforts to carry out his vision of justice. Vincenzo employs Myung Hee's tactics against her.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Jang Joon Woo reminds Jang Han Seo who's the boss. The tenants rally around Vincenzo and Cha Young, who team up to take down Babel Group.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Both sides use every trick in the book to cause disturbances in and out of the courtroom. Han Seung Hyuk and Myung Hee are introduced to Babel's CEO.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Stumped by surprise witnesses, Joon Woo and Myung Hee direct their rage toward Cha Young. The tenants gain new appreciation for their building.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: Angered by another conglomerate and its generations of unpunished crimes, Vincenzo tries to charm a young bank president out of investing in Babel.

episodes.title: Episode 9
episodes.summary: Joon Woo wields his power to force loyalty from his partners.  Cha Young finds refuge in Vincenzo's apartment following a break-in.

episodes.title: Episode 10
episodes.summary: Seeking revenge instead of liability for the loss of more innocent victims, Vincenzo put his life on the line to lure Babel's CEO out of hiding.

episodes.title: Episode 11
episodes.summary: The search for Jang Han Suk begins with torturing his lackeys for information. Ahn Gi Suk flashes his work badge to free Vincenzo from prosecution.

episodes.title: Episode 12
episodes.summary: Han Seo faces unintended consequences when he takes a shot at Babel's throne. Vincenzo and Cho Joo Young finally get Geumga Plaza to themselves.

episodes.title: Episode 13
episodes.summary: Joo Young reveals his true motive.  As incoming CEO, Han Suk is met with admiration, applause and a mafia styed-surprise from Vincenzo.

episodes.title: Episode 14
episodes.summary: To expose Han Suk's paper company, Vincenzo and Cha Young go undercover as an enamored couple. Seo Mi Ri reveals her high-tech tricks.

episodes.title: Episode 15
episodes.summary: With ample evidence to lock up Han Suk, Jung In Gook holds a press conference. Vincenzo channels spirits to turn an ill-famed newspaper against Babel.

episodes.title: Episode 16
episodes.summary: Maddened by Vincenzo's ability to slip out of another one of his bloody traps, Han-seok goes after what Vincenzo cherishes the most.

episodes.title: Episode 17
episodes.summary: A grieving Vincenzo crashes a party to bleed Babel Group dry of its powerful allies.  Seung-hyuk reaches out to a high level commander for help.

episodes.title: Episode 18
episodes.summary: Fearing for his life, Han-seok goes to jail to bide some time. A visitor from Italy tells Vincenzo his help is urgently needed back home.

episodes.title: Episode 19
episodes.summary: Vincenzo and Cha-young present damning evidence against Babel Tower and its influential cronies.  Myung-hee proves her loyalty toward Han-seok.

episodes.title: Episode 20
episodes.summary: Han Seok lets nothing stand in his way of revenge. Seeking justice the Mafia way, Vincenzo gives his enemies a slow and painful death.
